name: Melody Ebner
bio: A San Diego singer and songwriter with a degree in Music Education, Melody brings soulful vocals to intimate ceremonies and full-band sets. She has toured more than 35 states with Swift Nation Tribute, performing for audiences of up to 8,000, and performs with The Mighty Untouchables. Her four-year solo residency at Tommy Bahama shaped an approach that balances energy, atmosphere and room-conscious volume.

name: Johnathon Rodriguez
bio: Born in East Los Angeles and raised in Whittier, Johnathon began playing drums at eleven and performed at Carnegie Hall by thirteen. He has shared stages with Gwen Stefani, Lizzo, Kid Cudi and Flo Rida, and continues to tour nationally and internationally. Behind the kit and at the sound desk, he brings a performer’s ear to the whole room.

name: Tyler Van Dam
bio: Tyler is a Southern California saxophonist and clarinetist with more than fifteen years of performance experience. His career began with the Marine Forces Pacific Band in Hawaii and continued with Marine Band San Diego; he was named Marine Musician of the Year in 2017. His work spans jazz, Latin ensembles and ceremonial performances, with appearances across the United States, American Samoa and New Zealand.

name: Diego Moran
bio: Los Angeles bassist and music director Diego Alejandro Moran brings nearly three decades of experience to the stage and studio. His playing moves comfortably across styles, grounded in feel and an ability to adapt in the moment. As a music director, he helps the ensemble listen, respond and come together as one band.

name: Merv Douglas
bio: Merv is a groove-focused bassist and singer whose experience includes Powerman 5000, Lords of Acid, RevCo and Kidneythieves. He brings an expressive stage presence and an instinct for connecting with the people on the dance floor.
